desc:
Hide from the MURDERER. 🕵️

Props try to blend in. Murderers hunt them down before time runs out!

🎭 PROPS
• Morph into barrels, crates, chairs, shelves and more
• Rotate and scale your prop to hide better
• Drop clone decoys to fool the murderers
• Taunt to earn extra coins, if you dare

🔪 MURDERERS
• Hunt down every prop before the timer ends
• Stab or throw your knife
• Use your whistle once per round to make props reveal themselves

💰 Collect coins, open crates and unlock new knives and items.

#PropHunt #HideAndSeek #Murderer #Props #Morph #Hide #Seek #Multiplayer #Mystery #Fun #MM2 #MM2 Duels #Duels #Murder Mystery
